subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about driving validated leads for {Brand} across South Africa. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to the validated lead, a real buyer enquiry or seller listing that clears your own quality screen, read back through an S2S postback off your stack rather than counting installs. At scale that has held an eCPA on the validated lead of R38 (illustrative), with bot and recycled-device traffic rejected before billing. If it helps, I can pull the category-level validated-lead view for your markets. Worth a short look?
angle: warm bump, restate validated-lead quality proof
illustrative_flags: eCPA on the validated lead of R38 (MobUpps-specific cost-per-validated-lead; illustrative placeholder; never an established MobUpps result)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN classifieds South Africa: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof (validated-lead optimization + S2S postback + fraud screen before billing); one illustrative figure (eCPA R38, flagged inline and in illustrative_flags); soft CTA with 1 question mark; native English business register; no sign-off; no em dash; no 'X, not Y' (phrased positively as 'rather than counting installs').
